records.name: Highborne
records.summary: Being part of a Highborne community means you're accustomed to a life of elegance, opulence, and prestige within the upper echelons of society.

records.name: Loreborne
records.summary: Being part of a Loreborne community means you're from a society that favors strong academic or political prowess.

records.name: Orderborne
records.summary: Being part of an Orderborne community means you're from a collective that focuses on discipline or faith, and you uphold a set of principles that reflect your experience there.

records.name: Ridgeborne
records.summary: Being part of a Ridgeborne community means you've called the rocky peaks and sharp cliffs of the mountainside home.

records.name: Seaborne
records.summary: Being part of a Seaborne community means you lived on or near a large body of water.

records.name: Slyborne
records.summary: Being part of a Slyborne community means you come from a group that operates outside the law, including all manner of criminals, grifters, and con artists.

records.name: Underborne
records.summary: Being part of an Underborne community means you're from a subterranean society.

records.name: Wanderborne
records.summary: Being part of a Wanderborne community means you've lived as a nomad, forgoing a permanent home and experiencing a wide variety of cultures.

records.name: Wildborne
records.summary: Being part of a Wildborne community means you lived deep within the forest.
